Uttar Pradesh Government Increases Allowances for Outsourced Workers and Ration Dealers

The Uttar Pradesh government has announced a 5% increase in the honorarium for outsourced workers. Additionally, the commission for ration dealers in the state has been raised to ₹125 per quintal. These decisions are presented as significant benefits for the respective groups.
